states.meaning: A source asserts the proposition; support is not established.
Available evidence does not determine the proposition.
Required evidence is known not to exist or be retrievable.
No qualifying observation covers the proposition.
Evidence is insufficient to resolve among live alternatives.
The proposition is outside the case scope.

absence_rule: Missing proposition records do not imply FALSE or EVENT_ABSENT.
promotion_rule: Only a frozen positive rule may create a derived SUPPORTED proposition.
